world.title: China eyes huge naval guns to crush small drones as Trump brings back big battleships
world.summary: Chinese naval researchers are investigating the use of high-calibre naval guns as a cost-effective method for warships to defend against drone swarms. This development comes amid a renewed focus on large battleships, highlighted by former President Trump's advocacy. The research aims to enhance naval capabilities in modern warfare, particularly against the increasing threat posed by unmanned aerial vehicles.

world.title: Israel’s Katz threatens ‘full-scale war’ against PA after settler stabbed
world.summary: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz has threatened a “full-scale war” against the Palestinian Authority (PA) following the stabbing of a settler in the occupied West Bank. This incident occurs amid increasing violence, with Israeli settlers reportedly conducting pogroms against Palestinians. In response to the stabbing, Israeli forces killed the suspected attacker, a Palestinian man, shortly after the incident.

world.title: No winter in India in 2026? World Meteorological Organization warns of nearly 100% chance ‘Godzilla’ El Niño will affect temperatures till February 2027
world.summary: The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) has warned that a powerful El Niño is strengthening in the tropical Pacific, with nearly a 100% chance it will persist until February 2027. This phenomenon may lead to increased weather extremes globally, potentially altering temperature and rainfall patterns in India over the coming months, raising concerns about the absence of winter in 2026.

business.title: Udaan acquires Swiggy-owned LYNK Logistics for Rs 500 crore
business.summary: Udaan has acquired LYNK Logistics, a company owned by Swiggy, for Rs 500 crore. As part of the deal, Swiggy will obtain a 2.8% stake in Udaan and invest an additional Rs 75 crore in the B2B commerce platform. This acquisition aims to enhance Udaan's logistics capabilities within the retail distribution sector. The announcement was made on September 7.

business.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang says 'AGI has arrived' after OpenAI GPT-6 Astra rollout for which Sam Altman said ‘sorry’
business.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang congratulated OpenAI on the launch of its new model, Astra, stating that artificial general intelligence (AGI) has arrived. This announcement follows OpenAI's rollout of GPT-6. Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, acknowledged the significance of this development, expressing his apologies for any issues during the rollout. The advancements signal a notable milestone in AI technology.

business.title: There is a large inconsistency between GDP and other data series: Former Finance Secretary Subhash Chandra Garg
business.summary: Former Finance Secretary Subhash Chandra Garg has criticized India's GDP estimates, pointing out significant inconsistencies with other data series. He raised concerns about transparency and potential political interference in the data collection process. Garg suggested that the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation should create a clear connection between the 2011–12 and 2022–23 GDP series to enhance public trust.

technology.title: A Microsoft engineer says "typing code is absolutely over," here's what he means
technology.summary: A Microsoft engineer, Fowler, stated that "typing code is absolutely over," emphasizing that AI tools like GitHub Copilot are transforming software development. While developers remain essential, AI is increasingly managing routine tasks such as setting up environments, modifying repositories, running tests, and initiating pull requests. This shift allows engineers to focus more on higher-level problem-solving rather than individual coding.

technology.title: Vivo X500 Pro Max: Photo shows 400mm Zeiss camera quality
technology.summary: Vivo has released a photo sample from its new X500 Pro Max featuring a 400mm Zeiss teleconverter, showcasing sunset photography. The flagship camera also recorded a 4K video sample. The image highlights the device's capabilities, with a circular LED flash visible, confirming the use of the Vivo X500 Pro Max, which is currently protected by a case.

technology.title: Microsoft just stumbled onto a way to fix Windows 11, but it hasn't realized it yet
technology.summary: Microsoft's Project Zenith aims to enhance Windows 11 by offering a "distraction-free" experience, reducing clutter for users. However, this feature is currently limited to developers with high-end PCs. While the initiative may address some frustrations within the operating system, its accessibility remains a concern, as it targets a specific audience rather than the broader user base.

sports.title: Rohit Sharma-Virat Kohli threat looms over New Zealand: Mitchell Santner says 'not this time'
sports.summary: New Zealand captain Mitchell Santner anticipates a challenging series against India, particularly with the return of ODI specialists Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma. He acknowledges their significant impact on the game and emphasizes the need for his team to perform well. The upcoming matches are expected to be competitive as both teams prepare for the contest later this year.

sports.title: East Zone's 708 shows why a six-decade-old Indian domestic rule is increasingly out of step with modern cricket
sports.summary: East Zone's score of 708 in 163 overs highlights the limitations of India's long-standing first-innings lead rule in domestic cricket. This rule can incentivize teams to play conservatively rather than pursue outright victories. The recent Duleep Trophy final exemplified this, as South Zone won the trophy based on their first-innings lead despite the match ending in a draw.

sports.title: Duleep Trophy final: Advantage East Zone after Ishan Kishan's 270
sports.summary: Ishan Kishan scored a remarkable 270 runs, leading East Zone to a commanding position in the Duleep Trophy final against South Zone in Chennai. His double century, along with Kumar Kushagra's century of 101, contributed to a total exceeding 700 runs, marking only the third instance of such a score in first-class cricket at the venue.

health.title: Man Successfully Kept Alive with Pig Kidney for 271 Days Until He Could Receive a Human One
health.summary: Tim Andrews underwent a pioneering surgery at Massachusetts General Hospital, receiving a genetically modified pig kidney. The organ successfully functioned for 271 days, providing a temporary solution while he awaited a human kidney transplant. Medical professionals suggest that xenotransplantation could serve as a vital “bridge” for patients in need of human kidneys, potentially addressing the organ shortage crisis.

health.title: traumatic mental condition may contribute to heart risk, study finds
health.summary: Research indicates that mental health conditions arising from traumatic incidents may increase the risk of cardiovascular problems. These issues include non-fatal heart attacks, strokes, and fatal cardiac events. The study highlights the potential link between trauma-related mental health and future heart health, suggesting that addressing mental health may be crucial for reducing cardiovascular risks in affected individuals.

health.title: Weight-Loss Drugs May Raise Hair-Loss Risk In Men Genetically Prone To Baldness
health.summary: GLP-1 weight-loss drugs, including Ozempic, Wegovy, and Mounjaro, may increase the risk of hair loss in men genetically predisposed to baldness. Dermatologists indicate that rapid weight loss and inadequate nutrition could also contribute to temporary shedding. The use of these medications is rising, not only for obesity and diabetes treatment but also for quick weight loss solutions.

science.title: Scientists discovered an underwater city of 20,000 octopus nests deep inside California coast; largest known nursery on the planet
science.summary: Researchers have discovered the largest known octopus nursery off the Californian coast, termed the Octopus Garden. This underwater city contains approximately 20,000 octopus nests, with 5,718 individual octopuses documented across 2.5 hectares. The finding highlights significant biodiversity in the region and underscores the importance of marine habitats for the survival and reproduction of these cephalopods.

science.title: Bigger than Idaho!!! A 120-million-year-old volcanic giant has been building beneath the Pacific since the dinosaur age
science.summary: A massive volcanic superstructure, larger than Idaho, has been developing beneath the Pacific Ocean for over 120 million years. Researchers indicate that its formation resulted from numerous volcanic episodes rather than a single eruption. This discovery sheds light on geological processes and the long-term evolution of volcanic structures in the oceanic environment, highlighting the complexity of Earth's geological history.

science.title: Scientists find way to delay, potentially prevent quantum entanglement loss with single flip
science.summary: Scientists from India and the US have discovered a method to extend quantum entanglement duration by implementing a single, precisely timed flip operation. This research highlights the significance of intervention timing in managing quantum systems. The findings may contribute to enhancing the stability of delicate quantum links, which is crucial for the advancement of future quantum technologies.

entertainment.title: Bipasha Basu says she ‘started the trend’ of muscular women in Bollywood: ‘It's not just about looking good'
entertainment.summary: Bipasha Basu discussed her influence on promoting muscular female bodies in Bollywood, stating she initiated the trend despite initial resistance to muscular women in the industry. She emphasized the importance of self-love and a healthy lifestyle, asserting that women with muscle tone were not widely accepted as actresses before her efforts. Basu believes her advocacy has changed perceptions in Bollywood.

entertainment.title: Hanuman Ansh cast, crew quit; Neem Karoli Baba actor Shobhinaw was the ‘last man standing’
entertainment.summary: Most members of the "Hanuman Ansh" cast and crew have departed, believing the film will not be completed. Director Vishal Chaturvedi and actor Shobhinaw Satyaa discussed the challenges faced during production. Despite doubts, Chaturvedi remained committed to the project, inspiring the remaining team members to persist even when conditions seemed insurmountable. Shobhinaw was the last member to stay.

entertainment.title: I Am Game Opening Weekend Kerala Box Office: Dulquer Salmaan starrer witnesses underwhelming trend, collects Rs 13.70 crore in 4 days
entertainment.summary: Dulquer Salmaan's film I Am Game had a disappointing opening weekend at the Kerala box office, earning Rs 13.70 crore over four days. The movie experienced a decline in ticket sales throughout the weekend. Industry analysts suggest that it must demonstrate strong performance during the weekdays to improve its chances of success at the box office.
